services.name: Boating Class
services.desc: Come learn more about boating with a USCG licensed captain. This class is intended to be an easy going way to get some hands on practical knowledge of either boat maneuvering or local waterways knowledge. Already know how to drive a boat and want to learn more about the local waterways (where sandbars are, where to pull up and grab something to eat...)? We'll go on the water and actually see these places while being shown how to get there and areas to look out for. We can give you knowledge on the waterways of the Hilton Head / Daufuskie area. Waterway include: Broad creek, Calibogue Sound, Cooper River, May River, Scull Creek, Mackey's Creek Want to learn more about maneuvering a boat?

extraNote: We never hold weather against anyone! · The weather does change frequently and sometimes when it rains the sun comes back out 15 minutes later, so we will make the call on the day of the trip if we need to push or pull the time or change to another day that works for your group. · If we exhaust all those options and couldn’t get you on the water due to weather, it’s a 100% refund. · We hope that you would like that refund to be on a gift card that you can redeem at a later time! · If you need to cancel for something outside of weather like unfortunately someone is sick, we ask that you do that at least 48 hours in advance of the trip. · ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.co
